intro.text: A brightlord who once owned Kaladin as a slave.

items.text: Tasinar owned Kaladin after he was thrown out of Amaram's army. Kaladin befriended another of his slaves, Nalma, and led her and a few others in his most successful escape, hiding in the forest for about a week. Tasinar's hunting party of lighteyes closed in with brutal methods, and every escapee but Kaladin was killed.

personality.text: Like many lighteyes, he cares little for darkeyes' lives; when some of his slaves are killed, he complains about the loss of his property.
